name: notes-webapp

dependencies.name: notes-api
dependencies.description: Lists, reads, creates and pins notes.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs members in through the platform identity provider.

description: The single-page Team Notes app for signed-in members: notes list with pinned notes on top, a note reading view, a create-note form, and pin/unpin controls. Calls only notes-api. Does not hold any data or credentials.
